title: More Oil Is Not Extra Protection
topic: Oil above the upper mark is not extra protection
mechanicTruth: Engine oil belongs within the manufacturer-specified operating range; filling above the upper mark is not extra protection and can create lubrication or sealing problems depending on the engine.
